parts.name: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3 (SX1262) beacon
parts.note: $17.90-19.90, 21 dBm (page); mass, average draw (ESP32-S3 + 1 s TX per 30 s) and -20..70 C ASSUMPTION; LICENCE: a single-channel SF12 / 125 kHz beacon is not 47 CFR 15.247-legal: a 20-byte packet is ~1.3 s on air (Semtech SX127x time-on-air formula: 12.25 preamble + 28 payload symbols x 32.8 ms), over the 0.4 s per-channel dwell of 15.247(a)(1)(i) (which also needs >= 50 hop channels), and 125 kHz is under the 500 kHz minimum 6 dB bandwidth of a digital-modulation system (15.247(a)(2)). So it is flown under Part 97 in the 33 cm amateur band (902-928 MHz, 97.301(a), Technician and up) by the licensed operator, with the callsign in every packet (97.119) and no encryption (97.113(a)(4))
